title: AetherisRouteEvidence
description: OxDeAI non-authoritative routing audit artifact produced from WisePick ECU output.

decision_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the canonical preimage (audit metadata only; not an authorization input).

routing_decision_id.description: Optional WisePick /v1/decide decision_id. When present, included in the decision_hash preimage for audit correlation.

confidence_bps.description: Routing confidence in basis points (integer only).

latency_estimate_ms.description: Non-binding latency estimate in milliseconds (excluded from decision_hash preimage).

cost_estimate_millicents.description: Non-binding cost estimate in USD millicents (1 USD = 100_000; excluded from decision_hash preimage).
